title: uninstaller refuses -RecordAfter when there is no journal to append to
why: tools/uninstall.ps1 is the only optional write component and its provenance chain starts at -RecordBefore. Filling in an after value without a journal would invent provenance, so the tool must refuse (exit 2, reasonKey journal_required) instead of creating a half journal. This is the fail-closed refusal the design promises: nothing is written when the state is not coherent enough to act on.
inject: an empty fixture (no journal, no observations) plus -RecordAfter -AsJson, with an explicit -StateDir under the case temp dir
expectSummary: exit 2, summary.verdict=refused, refusals[0].reasonKey=journal_required, and the case temp dir is untouched
